Make sure it reaches by 7 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Horticulture or Agriculture or Plant Sciences of a recognized University or equivalent; Knowledge of all aspects of coconut cultivation, marketing and processing so as to be able to advise the Board on the implementation of suitable development programmes Experience: Ten years' experience in agricultural research/ development, extension, processing, marketing work with particular reference to coconut. For deputation: holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/Department, or 5 years' regular service in the grade in Level-11 (Rs. 67,700-2,08,700/-) or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open to officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, ICAR, Agricultural Universities, PSUs, recognized research institutions or councils, semi-government, autonomous or statutory organizations Deputation candidates must hold an analogous post on regular basis, or have 5 years' regular service in Level-11 (Rs. 67,700-2,08,700/-) or equivalent Directors in Level-11 working in the Coconut Development Board with the para 1(b) qualifications are also considered, on promotion basis Only officers who could be spared in the event of selection may apply Desirable: Doctorate of any of the subjects mentioned under essential qualifications Experience of preparation of development projects on the various aspects of the coconut industry Administrative experience in a responsible capacity Working knowledge of computers

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Officer on deputation may draw own pay plus deputation (duty) allowance or have pay fixed in the scale of the post as per DOPT's OM No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended. Deputation period, including preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years Selected Director of the Board is treated as appointed on promotion

content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Coconut Development Board, dated 21 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CDB Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CDB Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Chief Coconut Development Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CDB Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma printed with the advertisement) and send it to Under Secretary (MIDH), Horticulture Division, Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Krishi Bhawan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi-110001, by forwarded through proper channel by post; soft copy may also be emailed, to reach by 7 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-12 in the pay matrix (Rs. 78,800 - 2,09,200 ).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Horticulture or Agriculture or Plant Sciences of a recognized University or equivalent, knowledge of all aspects of coconut cultivation, marketing and processing, and ten years' experience in agricultural research/development, extension, processing, marketing work with particular reference to coconut. Deputation candidates must also hold an analogous post or have 5 years' regular service in Level-11.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, ICAR, Agricultural Universities, PSUs, recognized research institutions or councils, semi-government, autonomous or statutory organizations. Deputation candidates must hold an analogous post on regular basis, or have 5 years' regular service in Level-11 (Rs. 67,700-2,08,700/-) or equivalent. Directors in Level-11 working in the Coconut Development Board with the para 1(b) qualifications are also considered, on promotion basis. Only officers who could be spared in the event of selection may apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not received through proper channel. Applications received after due date or without APARs, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate and penalty statement, or otherwise incomplete.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of the application and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. The Selection Committee assesses the information in the CV and supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience at the time of selection. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of the selection committee for candidates otherwise well qualified.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation period, including preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years. Selected Director of the Board is treated as appointed on promotion.
